title: How many people live in each country?
prompt: Place each country by its 2025 population.

items.label: Iceland
items.fact: The World Bank lists Iceland's 2025 population growth rate at 1.5 percent.

items.label: New Zealand
items.fact: The World Bank lists New Zealand's 2025 population growth rate at 0.7 percent.

items.label: South Korea
items.fact: The World Bank lists South Korea's 2025 population growth rate at -0.1 percent.

items.label: Mexico

items.label: United States
items.fact: The World Bank lists U.S. population growth at 0.5 percent in 2025.

items.label: India
